The register search removed the systematic mean bias. The remaining errors may be explained by the tool’s four latent draws, which I will check separately.

I will collect more training states to estimate how dose changes move the value-head features. The proposed edit will target those directions while minimizing changes on factual records. Weakly identified directions or a large predicted factual cost would argue against this approach.
